light.$description: Where the one light source sits, shared by every product: After Graduation's wheel and Life Hub's sun. Glass everywhere is lit from here.

from-right.$description: How far in from the right edge the light's center sits. On phones it sits on the edge, clear of the title and subtitle.

top.$description: How far down from the top of the page the light's center sits: on the subtitle's line. Fixed, so the light never moves with what the header holds.
